title: Meet Pip (example)
about: A short hello for a stage or a classroom. Copy it to data/scripts/ and change the lines; your copy stays private. Steps: say, wait (with a cue for the presenter), face, drive, wheelie (with a fallback), journal. Manual: knowledge/manual/scripts.md.

steps.cue: YOU: I'd like you to meet a little robot. Pip, say hello!

steps.say: Hello everyone! I'm Pip, a little robot. I was built from spare parts, and I learn something new every day.

steps.cue: YOU: What do you do all day, Pip?

steps.say: I look around, I talk with my people, and I keep a journal, so I remember the important things.
Okay! Please give me some room.

steps.journal: I met a new group of people today and showed them a trick.
